name: Noopept
description: Ethyl ester of N-phenylacetyl-L-prolylglycine (omberacetam), a small dipeptide-like molecule from Russia

status.studiedFor: Mild thinking problems after brain injury

note.text: A few small Russian studies, mostly in Russian. No trial is registered on ClinicalTrials.gov.

bullets: **In rats,** raised activity of the NGF and BDNF genes in the hippocampus
**In mice,** prevented the memory deficit caused by scopolamine
**In people,** the mechanism is not established

practical.soldAs: Not FDA approved; FDA cited supplements containing it (2019)

regulatory.text: Not approved; cited in 2019 warning letters
Not named; S0 status not stated

references: FDA, health fraud page on Alzheimer's disease products, Nov 2026
Neurol Clin Pract, omberacetam and analogs in supplements, Jun 2021
J Xenobiot, medicines control laboratories on noopept, Jun 2025
